name: Testing whether explanations are trustworthy
gist: Many interpretation methods claim to explain models, but do they? These papers test whether explanations actually capture how models work or just sound convincing.
explain: Imagine a model that's good at predicting but gives explanations that sound plausible but are wrong. It might point to random parts of the input and claim they caused the output. To a human reader, the explanation might sound convincing, but it's false. This is a real danger: if we rely on interpretability methods that are themselves unreliable, we gain false confidence in a broken model. These papers ask a hard question: how do we know an explanation actually captures what the model is doing?

One approach is adversarial testing: design cases where you know the true explanation and see if the method finds it. Another is mechanistic verification: trace through the computation step-by-step to see if the highlighted inputs actually cause the output via the paths the explanation claims. A third is consistency: do different explanation methods agree? These papers also benchmark explanations against simpler proxy models. If the explanation helps a simple model achieve similar accuracy, that's evidence the explanation captures real structure, because a simpler model that learns from the same explanations will also need those explanations to be true in order to match the complex model's behavior. The goal is to move interpretation from an art (that sounds reasonable) to a science (that provably works).

papers.title: Divide and Abstract: Autoformalization via Decomposition and Abstraction Learning
papers.contribution: Improves performance up to 8.6x and advances SOTA by 57.8% from 40.8 to 64.4%, generalizing beyond training corpus without retraining.

papers.title: Faithfulness Under the Distribution: A New Look at Attribution Evaluation
papers.contribution: Produces significantly different and more reliable faithfulness judgments than prior approaches by avoiding common pitfalls of out-of-distribution perturbations.

papers.title: From Concepts to Components: Concept-Agnostic Attention Module Discovery in Transformers
papers.contribution: Demonstrates SAMD on concepts of varying complexity, showing attention module locations remain stable before and after LLM post-training.

papers.title: GNN Explanations that do not Explain and How to find Them
papers.contribution: Reveals failure modes in SE-GNN explanations and proposes reliable auditing mechanism for both malicious and natural degenerate explanations.

papers.title: Learning for Highly Faithful Explainability
papers.contribution: The approach produces more faithful explanations than existing methods while proving that an explanation mapping can achieve optimality simultaneously across multiple faithfulness metrics.

papers.title: Provably Explaining Neural Additive Models
papers.contribution: Enables efficient generation of cardinally-minimal explanations for NAMs while providing smaller and faster explanations than existing subset-minimal explanation algorithms.

papers.title: The Value of Information in Human-AI Decision-making
papers.contribution: ILIV-SHAP with AI predictions produces reliably greater error reductions over non-AI assisted decisions compared to vanilla SHAP on chest X-ray and deepfake detection.

papers.title: Training-free Counterfactual Explanation for Temporal Graph Model Inference
papers.contribution: Effectively discovers explanations with guarantees on temporal explainability and supports inference queries for dynamic network analysis.

papers.title: A Positive Case for Faithfulness: Explanations Help Predict Model Behavior
papers.contribution: Shows self-explanations substantially improve prediction of model behavior (11-37% NSG) and provide more predictive information than external model explanations, while also revealing 5-15% egregiously misleading explanations.

papers.title: Are LLM Evaluators Really Narcissists? Sanity Checking Self-Preference Evaluations
papers.contribution: Shows only 51% of prior findings retain significance against the evaluator quality baseline, covering 89.6% of reported self-preference probability mass, suggesting confounds in previous narcissism claims.

papers.title: Bridging Explainability and Embeddings: BEE Aware of Spuriousness
papers.contribution: BEE consistently exposes spurious correlations across vision and language datasets, including concepts that reduce ImageNet accuracy by up to 95% and clinical shortcuts causing dangerous false negatives in medical notes.

papers.title: Can LLMs Reason Structurally? Benchmarking via the lens of Data Structures
papers.contribution: Benchmarking 13 state-of-the-art LLMs reveals critical limitations with top model achieving only 0.46/1 on challenging instances, exposing poor spatial reasoning and code-based reasoning.

papers.title: Certified Evaluation of Model-Level Explanations for Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Provides the first theoretically certified framework for evaluating GNN explanations, revealing explanation quality differences hidden by class scores alone.

papers.title: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning In The Wild Is Not Always Faithful
papers.contribution: Reveals unfaithful CoT rates up to 13% in production models, with frontier models achieving lower rates (DeepSeek R1: 0.37%, Sonnet 3.7 with thinking: 0.04%).

papers.title: Compressed Sensing for Capability Localization in Large Language Models
papers.contribution: Zeroing as few as five task-specific heads degrades capability-specific performance by up to 60% while preserving unrelated tasks, revealing modular organization across 1B-14B parameter models.

papers.title: Directly Optimizing Natural Language Explanations for Behavioral Faithfulness: Simulatability and Recoverability
papers.contribution: Achieves high simulatability (~0.85) and recoverability (~0.99) with an 8B backbone, outperforming GPT-4o and human explanations by 15% in user studies.

papers.title: Does Higher Interpretability Imply Better Utility? A Pairwise Analysis on Sparse Autoencoders
papers.contribution: Analysis reveals only weak correlation between interpretability and utility (0.298); Delta Token Confidence improves steering performance by 52.52%, but this correlation vanishes after feature selection.

papers.title: Evaluating LLM Uncertainty in Long-Form Generation Using Deterministic Ground Truth
papers.contribution: Analyzes 50+ LLMs revealing confidence functions dominate uncertainty aspects; shows confidence ranking breaks at atomic level; identifies propagation and degradation as separable error drivers.

papers.title: Explanations are a Means to an End: Decision Theoretic Explanation Evaluation
papers.contribution: Provides practical validation workflow; instantiated in human-AI decision support and mechanistic interpretability scenarios.

papers.title: Hidden in Plain Sight -- Class Competition Focuses Attribution Maps
papers.contribution: Improve attribution specificity of 18 methods across 7 architectures up to 2x on common benchmarks via multi-class distribution analysis.

papers.title: Hide&Seek: Learning to Explain in an End-to-End Differentiable Network
papers.contribution: Hide&Seek outperforms existing state-of-the-art models across experiments, is fast to train, and achieves stable training via parsimony-weight annealing.

papers.title: Hierarchical Causal Abduction: A Foundation Framework for Explainable Model Predictive Control
papers.contribution: Improves explanation accuracy by 53% over LIME using cross-domain parameters; domain-specific tuning achieves 0.88 accuracy with validation across three control applications.

papers.title: INDUCTION: Finite-Structure Concept Synthesis in First-Order Logic
papers.contribution: The benchmark reveals sharp difficulty gradients and that compact formulas generalize far better than bloated ones, with parsimony separating concept recovery from finite-world fit.

papers.title: Learn from A Rationalist: Distilling Intermediate Interpretable Rationales
papers.contribution: REKD improves predictive performance of smaller neural networks and is model-agnostic, enabling integration with various BERT and vision transformer backbones.

papers.title: Multi-scale Explainer for Graph Neural Networks
papers.contribution: MSExplainer outperforms prior methods in explanation accuracy and fidelity with theoretically proven upper bound advantage while maintaining computational efficiency.

papers.title: On the Variability of Concept Activation Vectors
papers.contribution: Demonstrate that CAV variance declines roughly as 1/N where N is the number of random examples, providing practical resource-efficiency recommendations.

papers.title: Out-of-Distribution Evaluation of Rule-Based and Strategic Reasoning in Chess Transformers
papers.contribution: Model exhibits robust rule-based reasoning generating legal moves in novel configurations; strategic reasoning is more limited and underperforms symbolic AI algorithms.

papers.title: Query Circuits: Explaining How Language Models Answer User Prompts
papers.contribution: Shows sparse query circuits covering only 1.3% of model connections recover ~60% of performance on MMLU questions, providing scalable input-level explanations across benchmarks.

papers.title: Self-Consistency Improves the Trustworthiness of Self-Interpretable GNNs
papers.contribution: Consistently improves explanation quality across multiple dimensions and benchmarks by optimizing self-consistency, offering a scalable pathway to trustworthy GNN explanations.

papers.title: TT-Sparse: Learning Sparse Rule Models with Differentiable Truth Tables
papers.contribution: Forward pass remains sparse and transforms exactly into compact DNF/CNF Boolean formulas via Quine-McCluskey minimization, achieving superior predictive performance with lower complexity across 28 binary, multiclass, and regression datasets.

papers.title: Towards the Explainability of Temporal Graph Networks via Memory Backtracking and Topological Attribution
papers.contribution: Provides faithful explanations outperforming state-of-the-art baselines across nine temporal graph datasets spanning node prediction, link prediction, and graph classification.

papers.title: Unified Time Series Explanations via Amortized Optimization and Instance-level Multi-Expert Knowledge Distillation
papers.contribution: XMA attains best AUPRC on synthetic and MIT-ECG benchmarks with cardiologist-verified ground truth while amortizing explanation into lightweight learned inference.

papers.title: Visual symbolic mechanisms: Emergent symbol processing in Vision Language Models
papers.contribution: Uncovering previously unknown emergent symbolic mechanisms in VLMs that enable binding and explaining how they fail, offering avenues for reducing binding failures.

papers.title: When Language Models Lose Their Mind: The Consequences of Brain Misalignment
papers.contribution: Brain misalignment substantially impairs downstream performance across over 200 linguistic tasks, highlighting the critical role of brain alignment.
